comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
One of two Ancient Ganador superbosses which can be encountered during Ganador campaigns, and the weaker variant as indicated by the sickly yellow outline of his icon. For the stronger variant, visit Two-horned Great King instead.

Note that quote marks indicate Google Translated Japanese data. The rundown is as follows:

Map Type: Strait (Found when you "Leave the crossroads east and flank the three-way road")
Stats: Durability 9999, Crew 930
Special Effect: "Increase fire protection ability" / all-fleet magic attack (but like all Ganador super-bosses, this is only used if you provoke him with magic items such as an Amulet of the Sun)

Upon defeat, this boss can randomly drop the following:

Dhul-Qarnayn (MA Item)
Large Storm Sail
Nocturnal Wooden Paneling
Aide Training
Breath of Fortitude
Apollo's Torchlight

However! Before you go rushing off to farm Nocturnal panels or the like, please understand that the above loot table is taken from a Japanese UWO wiki. While player equipment is (mostly) confirmed to be unchanged, I would be amazed if some of the other highly coveted/valuable goodies were not removed/substituted for Maris international server.

And sadly I cannot beat Ancient Ganadors, so unless other players or the GMs wish to state what the new loot tables are, please don't get your hopes up too high.

Cheers.
